newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran blames Israeli for clashes.
newsitem.headline: Iran blames Israeli for clashes.

text.p: Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani on Friday blamed Israel for provoking violent clashes with Palestinians by opening a tunnel near a Moslem shrine in Jerusalem.

"It is clear that when you (Israelis) dig a tunnel under a Jerusalem shrine...you are provoking the Moslems. This is the best proof that you lie when you say you seek peace," Rafsanjani said in a mass prayer sermon broadcast on Tehran radio.
He was referring to three days of clashes that have killed 52 Palestinians and 13 Israeli soldiers, according to Palestinian medical officials and Israeli security sources.
The clashes broke out after Israel opened a tunnel near the al-Aqsa mosque in Jerusalem, Islam's third holiest shrine.
"It was clear from the start that there were strong time-bombs in the imposed compromise talks, waiting to explode some day," Rafsanjani told worshippers at Tehran University.
He was referring to the Middle East peace process that Iran has condemned as a sellout of Palestinian rights.
He said peace was impossible as long as the problem of Palestinian refugees was not addressed and Israel did not cease its "expansionism."
Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati told Tehran radio on Thursday night: "What is happening throughout Palestine today is a genuine uprising".
"We strongly support the Moslem Palestinian people's demand to preserve the Islamic identity of Palestine and Jerusalem and condemn this ugly move of the Zionists (Israelis)," he added.
